jobs.title: IT Application Developer
jobs.description:
**Help shape the future of smart manufacturing.**

We're looking for a **Software Developer** to design, develop and support manufacturing applications that enable reliable, secure and efficient production operations. In this role, you'll work with modern technologies, collaborate with business and IT teams, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our manufacturing systems.

### **What you'll do**

* Design, develop and implement software solutions that meet business and technical requirements.
* Ensure applications are scalable, secure, high-performing and reliable.
* Support the full application lifecycle, from implementation and enhancement to maintenance and retirement.
* Participate in application upgrades, including testing, deployment, version management and validation.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, including participation in an on-call support rotation.
* Configure and customize applications to meet manufacturing business needs, working closely with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Apply development best practices, coding standards and modern ways of working.
* Identify and implement improvements to enhance application performance, availability and reliability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to integrate applications and ensure seamless data flow across systems.
* Maintain high-quality technical documentation, including user guides, configuration documentation and knowledge base articles.
* Ensure compliance with IT security policies and industry standards while protecting sensitive business data.
* Contribute to process improvements and continuous development of manufacturing applications.
* Always follow company safety rules and regulations.

### **What you'll bring**

* B.Sc. in Information Systems, Information Technology or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience developing software using technologies such as **C/C++**, **C#**, **PL/SQL** or **JavaScript**.
* Knowledge of **DevOps tools** (e.g. Git) and modern software development practices.
* Experience with **server operating systems**, **Oracle**, **MySQL** or other database technologies.
* Understanding of **cloud technologies**.
* Experience with **MES/MOM**, **OCP** or similar manufacturing execution systems is highly valued.
* Knowledge of IT security best practices and compliance standards.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills in English.

jobs.title: Reload and Core Management Engineer
jobs.description:
The Nuclear Fuel Engineer will make immediate contributions to BWR fuel reload licensing and cycle management in GNF-A Fuels Engineering while being technically mentored by a team of high-performing engineers. In this role, you will provide innovative licensing and design solutions that ensure high-quality deliverables in accordance with customer requirements, business procedures, and regulatory agency guidelines. Additionally, this position offers direct utility customer-facing opportunities through deliverables, collaboration, and training.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* + Apply analytical methods, procedures, and techniques to solve complex problems
  + Execute analysis and design calculations to support operating reactor cores in reload licensing and cycle management
  + Prepare and present technical data to internal and external customers
      
    Document and communicate results of technical data generated
  + Maintain and/or exceed baseline project schedule and cost in the delivery of nuclear fuel reload engineering deliverables
  + Share information and promote open dialogue, including working effectively in a matrixed team environment
  + Ensure work is performed with high quality in accordance with NRC rules and regulations, customer requirements, and business quality assurance standards
  + Partner with Commercial Account Managers (CAMs), interface with customer technical personnel, and manage reload projects across the Fuels organization
  Engage in continuous professional development

**Required Qualifications**

* + Bachelor of Science Degree or equivalent in engineering, physics, or another science field from an accredited university.

**Desired Characteristics**

* + Master of Science Degree in Nuclear Engineering
  + Experience with Boiling Water Reactor (BWR) technology
  + Experience with BWR core simulator and use of 3-Dimensional neutron kinetics codes
  + Programming experience with Python or C#
  + Detail oriented and accountable for results
  + Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
  + Excellent oral & written communication skills

**Additional Information**

* + GE Vernova Engineering Innovation Center (EIC) in Warsaw, Poland is an integral part of the global engineering structure of GE Vernova. The site was officially founded in 2007, as GE Gas Power focused engineering organization. Currently the site extends engineering activities for GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy in Poland.
  + GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
  + *GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in Poland for this opening. This position requires access to and/or use of information subject to U.S. Export Control Laws, which mandate all citizenships be from the U.S. Department of Energy’s List of Generally Authorized Countries (10 CFR Part 810 Appendix A); otherwise a specific authorization from the U.S. Department of Energy will be required. More information can be found here:* *https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/10-cfr-part-810*

**Additional Information**
==========================

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Booking Engine
jobs.description:
#### **About Tripstack**

Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.

Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform - giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non-partner, low-cost and full-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost-effective API.

Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.

Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.

For more information, visit:

www.tripstack.com

www.etraveligroup.com

#### **The Role**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Booking Engine organization. You will own the technical direction of systems at the core of our product - pricing, availability and booking flows that serve millions of requests per day. Beyond writing code, you will set architectural direction, unblock others, and represent the team's technical position to product and to peer engineering groups.

This role suits someone who is a natural problem solver, detail-oriented, and comfortable moving between deep individual contribution and technical leadership in a fast-paced environment.

This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership scope. We do not have a separate formal tech lead title.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Set and drive the technical direction for one or more Booking Engine services - make architecture decisions, document the trade-offs, and act as the technical point of contact in planning, prioritization and dependency discussions
* Design, write, review, test and support C#/.NET code for reliable, high-quality systems at scale serving millions of requests per day
* Break large initiatives into deliverable increments - design solutions, get them reviewed, create stories, deliver and maintain
* Own latency, availability and cost characteristics of your services, and keep them within the reliability targets the organization sets
* Maintain and evolve our gRPC-based API 2.0 alongside the .NET services it fronts, keeping the two in step as the API surface changes
* Proactively identify technology opportunities for the company, and push technical ideas, proposals and plans to the entire organization
* Work cross-functionally with product managers, client integration teams and other engineering groups to deliver high-quality products and improve internal KPIs
* Coordinate and monitor regular releases to production
* Participate in the on-call support rotation, lead the team through incidents impacting live systems, and drive follow-up actions to completion
* Raise the engineering bar, mentor engineers through interactive code review, design review and knowledge-sharing sessions, and help the team make good use of AI-assisted development tooling

#### **Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related technical field experience
* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with C# and .NET, including production work on .NET Core / .NET 8+
* Strong command of the .NET runtime under load, including performance trade-offs, caching, profiling and benchmarking
* Strong software design and architecture skills - CS fundamentals, object-oriented analysis and design patterns, and large-scale distributed systems
* Hands-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent AI coding assistants in production work, with sound judgement about when to rely on them and how to review what they produce
* Proven track record of designing and architecting scalable, high-availability distributed systems serving internet traffic direct to consumers or businesses at scale
* Demonstrated technical leadership, having led the design and delivery of a significant system across multiple engineers and grown the engineers around you
* Experience owning production services on call, including leading incident response
* Ability to clearly and concisely communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization

#### **Additional Experience That Would Be Considered An Asset**

* Experience designing and publishing client SDKs or public-facing APIs consumed by external partners
* Experience with hybrid Google Cloud Platform or other cloud providers and cloud-native architecture alongside local data centre deployments
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD tooling
* Experience with monitoring dashboards (Grafana), alerting, logging, and PCI-related work
* Experience with gRPC and protobuf-based service contracts
* Experience with event-driven and asynchronous architectures, including message brokers and delivery guarantees
* Experience in the flight booking domain

#### **Benefits**

We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!

At Tripstack, we proudly believe in embracing diversity. This is true for our team, clients, communities and stakeholders. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating a safe, healthy and accessible environment. We encourage applications regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other grounds protected by law. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during any part of the recruitment process.

Tripstack thanks all applicants for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.  
  
Learn more about us at www.tripstack.com  
  
#tripstack

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Platform
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape how development teams across Sandvik build and operate integrations at scale? Join us in creating the platform capabilities, automation and templates that enable secure self-service delivery across the organization.

Some of the things you'll do:

* Build reusable capabilities that reduce manual work and enable independence.
* Influence the developer experience across APIs, integrations a nd event-driven solutions.
Collaborate closely with architects, product specialists, and development teams.  

**Your mission**

In this position, you focus on building the tools, templates, and automation that enable development teams to create and operate integrations independently. Experience with end-to-end integration delivery is great to have, although this work centers on reusable platform capabilities rather than individual integrations. Working from vendor-agnostic principles, you turn standards and architectural direction into practical platform capabilities that perform reliably in production. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

* Build and maintain our self-service integration builder using reusable platform components, templates and shared services for APIs, integrations and event-driven solutions built on top of Azure Integration Services.
* Develop CI/CD pipelines, automation services and utilities that support platform delivery and operations.
* Embed security, logging, reliability, quality and compliance controls into pipelines and templates.
* Translate architecture and technical standards into consistent, production-ready implementation patterns.
* Onboard and support development teams using the platform, improving its capabilities based on their feedback.
Troubleshoot live integrations and take ownership of platform components in production.  

**Location**

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

**Your profile**

You’re an experienced engineer with a strong software development foundation and exposure to platform engineering, DevOps and enterprise integration environments. Translating architectural direction and technical standards into reusable solutions comes naturally to you, and you enjoy creating capabilities that other development teams can adopt with confidence.

Your background also includes:

* Hands-on production experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management (APIM), and Service Bus or Event Grid.
* Strong programming skills in C# or Python, combined with the ability to write and troubleshoot Bash and/or PowerShell scripts.
* Experience with integration patterns, including APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture, and API gateways or enterprise integration platforms.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep or similar), and cloud-native environments.
Experience working with distributed systems and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.  

Additionally, experience with front-end technologies such as React or Angular, as well as relational and NoSQL databases, is considered an advantage.

With a developer-first mindset, you balance high technical standards with pragmatic decisions that move work forward. You communicate complex topics clearly, collaborate constructively, and take ownership of what you build, while continuously improving the experience for teams using the platform.

**Our culture**

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub , LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Delivery
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to combine hands-on software engineering with end-to-end ownership to build APIs and integrations that support business-critical operations while contributing to a reusable integration platform. Welcome to Sandvik Group IT!

Some of the things you'll do here:

* Build and own integrations from initial design through deployment and production support.
* Work with modern engineering practices covering APIs, automation, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
Turn delivery experience into reusable components, templates and technical improvements.  

**Your mission**

In this role, you design, develop and maintain custom integrations and APIs for business areas and projects built natively on Azure Integration Services. Your work combines hands-on engineering with production responsibility, and you ensure that each delivery follows standardized patterns for security, logging, monitoring, resilience and error handling. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

* Design and develop production-ready APIs and integrations using synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven patterns with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management.
* Build integration logic, APIs and automation components in C# or Python, supported by Bash or PowerShell scripting.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code for repeatable, automated deployments.
* Implement technical guardrails for authentication, authorization, secrets, certificates, networking, logging, monitoring and policy validation.
* Own live integrations in production, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident resolution and performance improvements.
Convert delivery learnings into reusable templates, platform components, runbooks, post-mortems and clear technical documentation.  

**Location**

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

**Your profile**

You’re an experienced integration engineer with a strong background in building and operating enterprise integrations. Combining software engineering with integration expertise, you understand how APIs, cloud services, automation and operations come together to create secure, reliable and maintainable solutions.

Your background also includes:

* Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management. You’ve designed resilient integrations with effective retry, error-handling and monitoring approaches and understand the engineering practices required to operate integrations in production.
* Strong programming skills in C# or Python, alongside experience using Bash or PowerShell for deployment and operational automation.
* Practical knowledge of REST APIs, messaging, asynchronous communication, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated deployments and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep or similar technologies.
Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerization, observability, resilience, security controls, and production support.  

Methodical and pragmatic in your approach, you stay composed when solving incidents and complex technical challenges. You take ownership, listen closely to business needs, and make sound decisions that balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability. Collaboration comes naturally, and you enjoy sharing knowledge with architects, platform engineers, product stakeholders, and other delivery teams.

**Our culture**

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative, and entrepreneurial.
